description.value: Nesters Market is a BC-born neighbourhood grocery chain founded in Whistler in 1987 and now operating over 16 locations across Western Canada. The Fraser Heights location is a full-service supermarket operated by the Pattison Food Group, stocking a broad range of fresh, natural, organic, and specialty products. Touring cyclists will find it a reliable resupply stop with an in-store deli and bistro, bakery, and pharmacy on site.
